generation_request: Bright blue-sky fantasy world, grassland overlook, distant castle/village, cute stylized adventurer and companion; cinematic intro landing on a living title composition.
processing: Three generated key visuals are reframed from clean image regions and interpolated into one H.264 timeline: the first 8.45s is the cinematic flight, followed immediately by a 5.05s subtle-motion Living Still section. Runtime loops only that tail segment in the same video element, so intro->title has no source swap. The title and menu remain live HTML and are not baked into the media. Media is embedded as data URLs so DEV/build deployments are self-contained.
fallback: Existing title-assets/world.webp and prepared title-live canvas are used only when movie playback is unavailable or motion is disabled.
